title: agentrc Agent Package
description: The agentrc (0.1.0-draft.6) agent package manifest, derived from the org.agentrc.* OCI labels emitted when an Agentfile is compiled. A platform reads this view (the labels), never the Agentfile source.

agentfile_syntax.description: The Agentfile syntax directive the package was built with.

identity.description: Who/what the agent is. Derived from org.agentrc.identity.* labels (IDENTITY keyword).

examples.name: claims-triage
examples.author: acme
examples.description: Triages insurance claims by severity and routes escalations

capabilities.description: Supported modalities/patterns. Derived from org.agentrc.capability.* labels (CAPABILITY keyword).

sop.description: Pointer and digest for the agent's system prompt / objective, embedded at /mnt/SOP. Derived from org.agentrc.sop and org.agentrc.sop.sha256 (the label is a pointer plus digest, never the full text).

path.description: The readable SOP file location inside the projection.

sha256.description: Digest of the embedded SOP file.

resources.description: Tools, skills, and MCP servers added with COPY (local) or ADD --remote. The destination path under /mnt determines the kind. Derived from org.agentrc.tool.* / skill.* / mcp.* labels and their .origin pairs.

kind.description: Resource type, determined by the /mnt subtree the resource lands in (/mnt/tools, /mnt/skills, /mnt/mcp).

delivery.description: How the resource is delivered: local (COPY), cached (ADD --remote --cached, embedded as a layer at build), or runtime (ADD --remote --runtime, fetched at bootstrap).

digest.description: Resolved content digest for an embedded resource.

origin.description: Origin reference, emitted alongside the digest for embedded MCP servers and skills so a platform may re-point to an internal mirror without rebuilding (org.agentrc.<kind>.<name>.origin).

fail_mode.description: What happens if the resource cannot be resolved: fail (--fail-if-unavailable, default) or warn (--warn-if-unavailable).

policy.description: Typed requests the platform grants, narrows, or rejects. Derived from POLICY-line labels org.agentrc.agent.* / substrate.* / model.* / network.dns.*.

agent.description: Agent-side operational constraints, state, and lifecycle (org.agentrc.agent.*).

labels.description: The raw org.agentrc.* label set as read from the OCI image config, for platforms that prefer the flat view.
